provenance.allowed: aggregate marginals only; no per-recording frames/audio/pose/trajectory/layout/event boundaries; no test-score tuning

mixture.policy: one coverage parent every 10 scene indices; cycle distinct speakers 0..8; visible-count cycle offset keeps a visible silent person in zero-speaker worlds

people_count.scope: detected people in horizontal 360-degree panorama band, not people inside one 85-degree crop and not true room occupancy

posture.unresolved_policy: independent engineering randomization; not recovered real postures
posture.runtime_policy: requests only; use only an admitted action, never silently replace sitting/walking/crouching with standing

concurrent_speakers.scope: concurrent distinct speaking actor IDs per 100 ms; not distinct speakers per 10-second window
concurrent_speakers.identity_pool_status: independent engineering choice, not a measured 10-second unique-speaker distribution
concurrent_speakers.hold_duration_status: independent engineering blocks; never copied real event boundaries

speech_distance_m.sampling: monotone inverse CDF through both aggregate bin masses and supplied quantiles; independent uniform draws; native feasibility remains mandatory
speech_distance_m.coverage_range_status: independent design sweep; SAVVY public range only, no empirical SAVVY probabilities

azimuth.policy: no out-of-frame reweighting; camera and source directions independent; native full frustum and occlusion determine truth

clothing_colour.mode: retain independent appearance seed and existing admitted palette

admission: sampler requests only; native layout, licensed assets/actions/recorded dry, RIR and original QA evidence must pass; no fallback to frozen alpha or two-person canary
